description: One send-ledger record, minted only through engine.record_send by the four producer classes (wait-rule engine, owner verbs, handler actions, continuation pass). Shadow sends (mode: shadow) are never dispatchable. The dispatch subrecord carries the claim lifecycle: claim by one attributed consumer on a 15-minute lease (expiry applied at read time); delivered only via ack by the claiming consumer carrying the fulfillment's submission reference as delivery_ref; failure records are never acks. bridge_request_id joins the ledger entry to its scheduler-side bridge record while a bridge hop is outstanding (contract 05).
title: Send record + dispatch subrecord (contract 05)
